nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers at 9:00 AM ET on weekdays (Mon-Fri) for daily standup

nodes.name: Fetch TRADE Project

options.jql: project = TRADE AND sprint in openSprints() AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches open sprint issues from TRADE project

nodes.name: Fetch INFRA Project

options.jql: project = INFRA AND sprint in openSprints() AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches open sprint issues from INFRA project

nodes.name: Fetch LEARN Project

options.jql: project = LEARN AND sprint in openSprints() AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches open sprint issues from LEARN project

nodes.name: Fetch MGMT Project

options.jql: project = MGMT AND sprint in openSprints() AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches open sprint issues from MGMT project

nodes.name: Fetch Agent Heartbeats
nodes.notes: Fetches current agent heartbeat status

nodes.name: Fetch Yesterday Completed

options.jql: status changed to Done AFTER -1d ORDER BY resolved DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches issues completed in the last 24 hours across all projects

nodes.name: Merge All Data
nodes.notes: Combines all parallel data fetches into single item

nodes.name: Aggregate Sprint Data
nodes.notes: Aggregates and categorizes all sprint data into structured standup format

nodes.name: Format Standup Message
nodes.notes: Formats the aggregated data into a Discord-formatted standup message

nodes.name: Post to Daily Standup
nodes.notes: Posts the formatted standup to #daily-standup channel

nodes.name: Check Blockers Exist
nodes.notes: Checks if there are blockers that need a MGMT ticket

nodes.name: Create MGMT Ticket

additionalFields.description:
={{ 'The following blockers were identified in today's standup:

' + $json.data.blockers.map(b => '- [' + b.key + '] ' + b.summary).join('
') + '

Please review and help resolve these blockers.' }}

nodes.notes: Creates a MGMT ticket to track standup blockers

nodes.name: Notify Chief About Blockers

parameters.content:
:warning: **Blockers Detected in Standup**

Created MGMT ticket **{{ $json.key }}** to track {{ $('Format Standup Message').first().json.data.blockers.length }} blockers.

Please review and prioritize resolution.

nodes.notes: Notifies #chief channel about blockers and the MGMT ticket

nodes.name: No Blockers Path
nodes.notes: No blockers - continue to completion

nodes.name: Log Standup Completion
nodes.notes: Logs standup completion to audit trail

nodes.name: Workflow Complete
nodes.notes: End node - standup workflow completed

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches any errors in this workflow

nodes.name: Format Error
nodes.notes: Formats error for Discord notification

nodes.name: Post Error
nodes.notes: Posts error to #n8n-errors channel
